_comment: Lucid Dreamer config. Install at <PROFILE_HOME>/lucid/lucid.config.json. The scripts auto-detect every path from their own location; the only value you MUST set is vault_path. Everything else has working defaults.
_comment_review: Windows paths work fine here — use forward slashes (C:/Users/<name>/Documents/<agent>-workspace/Vault) or escaped backslashes. Forward slashes are less error-prone.
_comment_exclude: Session IDs containing any of these substrings are skipped when building daily notes. Keep the lucid entries: without them the agent dreams about its own dreaming.
_comment_exclude_text: Optional regexes; any message matching one is dropped from daily notes. Use for retired workflows or noisy automation. Empty by default.
_comment_topics: Topic clustering for trend detection AND the vault graph. Keys are display names, values are lowercase substrings. Replace these with what the owner actually works on — the defaults are generic on purpose. Short, distinctive keywords work best.
_comment_colors: Graph-view colour per topic (hex, no #). Any topic without an entry is grey. Purely cosmetic.
_comment_categories: Colour per fact category (facts.category in the DB). Unknown categories fall back to grey. Optional.
_comment_projects: Only useful once the owner has several distinct projects. Colouring by PROJECT reads far better than by category on a multi-project graph. project_category_prefixes maps a category prefix to a project name, e.g. {"gm_": "game-project"}. Both empty by default.
